newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed, volume thin.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed, volume thin.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures ended mixed on Friday in very thin volume, amid a lack of fresh fundamental factors to lend the market direction, traders said.
TOCOM yen-based aluminium futures closed 0.1 yen lower to 0.9 yen higher, with the benchmark February 1998 contract down 0.1 yen at 204.2 yen per kg.
The day's volume was 1,978 lots, the lowest since the contract was listed on April 7.
Most players were sidelined today, due to a lack of market-moving factors, traders said. "The grain markets such as corn and soybeans are currently more active," a brokerage house trader said.
"It's difficult to do arbitrage between TOCOM and the spot market, given the low liquidity," an aluminium trader at a major trade house said.
